layers.authority: Parks Australia, with Aṉangu Traditional Owners (joint management)
layers.process: A park pass is needed, separate from Kakadu's. A 3-day adult pass is reported as A$38 and an annual pass A$50; under-18s free.

zone-requirements.note: Read prices from the Parks Australia page. Ask Parks Australia about permits for filming or commercial photography (not read on the pass page).

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Greet Aṉangu with 'palya'. Some find constant eye contact uncomfortable; silence usually means someone is thinking. Ask before photographing Aṉangu; commercial images need a permit.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Don't enter or photograph restricted areas, including sacred sites, ceremonial sites, burial grounds and homes. Stay on marked tracks and don't climb rock formations or boulders.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Aṉangu traditional owners and Parks Australia (joint management).
